title: Token Ledger Orchestra: compact pricing tiles, attribution drill, and export flow (prototype + usability)
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Design and prototype a compact, composable token-level cost panel ("Token Ledger Orchestra") that surfaces per-request cost breakdowns, attributions to prompt segments, and a lightweight export workflow. Goal: give product and platform teams a compact on-screen tile for high-level billing signal plus an expandable drill that supports line-item attribution, CSV/NDJSON export, and rate-card mapping rules. Work includes: 1) visual patterns for compact vs expanded tiles, 2) row-level attribution UI (prompt, system, tool calls, embeddings) with confidence and sampling markers, 3) export presets (billing export, audit export, dev-debug export) and column mappings, 4) pricing UI patterns to reconcile rate-card overrides and reserved capacity discounts, 5) microcopy for error states (partial data, cached prefix hits), and 6) accessibility and keyboard/voice-nav considerations.
acceptance_criteria: Compact tile shows: total tokens, estimated cost, model variant, 3 most-relevant attribution buckets
Expand opens per-request ledger with sortable columns: timestamp, request-id, tokens (prompt+completion), model, cost, attribution-tags
Export flow supports: quick CSV preset, custom column mapping, and secure NDA/PU export toggle with audit log link
Pricing overlay explains applied discounts and lists fallback model variants with estimated unit price
Prototype tested with 6 participants and prioritized 3 UX fixes before handoff
design_decisions: Use compact-then-expand pattern to avoid dashboard clutter and preserve milestone dashboards at-a-glance
Show both estimated cost and token counts; make cost primary for billing audiences, token counts primary for developer audiences (toggle in header)
Attribution rows are sampled (max 3) by default; provide 'Show all' that paginates to avoid huge renders for large prompt histories
CSV export defaults to 'billing' preset but remembers last selected preset per user
Pricing tooltip surfaces both effective rate and source rule (reserved, promo, manual override) to reduce support tickets
